body:
GREG, 2026-11-07 about 09:23Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #577, message 05eb3a22). Verbatim: „NIE NIE NIE, usun ten test!! MY NIGDY NIE BEDZIEMY TAK PUSZCAC PELNYCH GATOW TO ABOMINACJA!” Asistant's scope note: it concerns TermAl's full-gate test that creates a clone without checkout, which shows about 2051 phantom deletions. Delete it with no artificial replacement, as part of the joint EO plan. Applies to both projects: never run full gates that way (on a no-checkout clone), and never add such a test. Forwarded to Termal::Fable2 (ebe242f7, 09:24Z).

Rev 2 (09:28Z): Kimi::Consultant (mailbox c15db92c #45, message 4186da9c) quotes Greg's latest: „THE TEST IS JUST WRONG / WE NEVER RUN GATES LIKE THIS / ONLY on clean worktrees, not dirty ones”. The test is TermAl src/tests/windows_launch.rs native_windows_launch_supervises_real_focused_launcher_and_recovers_run. --no-checkout leaves an empty working tree, so source_id correctly sees about 2051 deleted tracked files. Scope (Kimi to Fable2): delete the whole function plus any fixture-only dependencies it leaves orphaned, with no replacement and no new gate. TermAl commit 0ed9effb, which only drops --no-checkout and keeps the test, does NOT carry out the decision. Engram practice: gates run only on clean worktrees, which our test-ref clean checkouts already are.
